newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt lifted by vague takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Reckitt lifted by vague takeover talk.

text.p: Shares in household products group Reckitt and Colman Plc rose on Friday on the re-emergence of rumours of a takeover bid by Anglo-Dutch group Unilever Plc, traders said.
The shares were up 15p to 962-1/2p in relatively slim volume by 1354 GMT.
"The gentlemen with dark glasses are back trying to buy the stock on the hope that they're going to be bid for. But the stock is not terribly liquid," said one senior dealer.
Earlier, Unilever said in its interim results statement that the sale of its speciality chemicals business to ICI had transformed Unilever's net debt position to a net cash position of 2.8 bln stg.
Unilever's net gearing as a result of the sale was zero compared to 35 percent at the same time last year.
"Reckitt is top of the pops in terms of bid rumours, and Unilever is the most widely talked about likely bidder," another dealer said.
